directive: V19.0 Phase 3 Data Gap Recovery Plan
prioritization_formula: frequency × estimated_predictive_relevance × recoverability × temporal_safety × source_reliability × operational_feasibility

gap_investigations.what_is_missing: Pre-kickoff closing 1X2 market prices in historical seasons prior to 2024/2025 (PSCH/B365CH absent in 1920-2324).
gap_investigations.how_often_missing: 65.4% across 6-season corpus; 100% missing in 1920-2324; 12.1% missing in 2425-2526.
gap_investigations.why_missing: Historical football-data CSVs prior to 2024 only collected opening bookmaker quotes; closing snapshot API capture began recently.
gap_investigations.recovery_cost: LOW (already integrated into CLV capture daemon for new fixtures; historical archive backfill requires paid quota).
gap_investigations.materially_improve_model: CRITICAL for C6 market benchmarking and closing edge quantification. Does NOT affect pre-match model feature vector (which strictly uses opening odds to prevent lookahead).

gap_investigations.what_is_missing: Starting XI lineups and confirmed player absence vectors.
gap_investigations.how_often_missing: 100% in pure football-data CSVs; available via API-Football / Sportmonks only within 60 minutes of kickoff.
gap_investigations.why_missing: Lineups are officially published by leagues only 60-75 minutes before kickoff. Historical match CSVs do not contain lineup records.
gap_investigations.pit_safe_reconstruction: CONDITIONAL (requires strict timestamp verification that lineup was published prior to inference timestamp).
gap_investigations.recovery_cost: MEDIUM (API quota and latency budget; must handle late publication).
gap_investigations.materially_improve_model: HIGH for match-day prediction refinement, but cannot be used for earlier pre-match forecasts (>3h before kickoff) without inducing data gaps.

gap_investigations.what_is_missing: Pre-match rolling expected goals for and against (rolling 5 and 10 matches).
gap_investigations.how_often_missing: 0% for EPL, La Liga, Serie A, Bundesliga, Ligue 1 in Understat corpus; 100% missing for Eredivisie (Understat does not cover Eredivisie).
gap_investigations.why_missing: Understat does not track the Dutch Eredivisie; StatsBomb requires proprietary enterprise licensing for full domestic coverage.
gap_investigations.recovery_cost: LOW for 5 leagues; HIGH for Eredivisie without licensed provider.
gap_investigations.materially_improve_model: MODERATE (+0.0008 RPS improvement in top 5 leagues; dropping Eredivisie violates 6-league canonical scope).

gap_investigations.feature_family: Dynamic Elo & Match Momentum (M2 Family A)
gap_investigations.what_is_missing: Dynamic Elo ratings, trend over last 5 matches, and momentum cross.
gap_investigations.how_often_missing: 0% missing. Fully replayed over all 6 leagues and 7 seasons.
gap_investigations.why_missing: Previously zero-filled in v5_phase7 serving due to missing replay wiring (docs/DEBT.md item 48).
gap_investigations.recovery_cost: ZERO (in-repo algorithm with identical train/serve parity).
gap_investigations.materially_improve_model: VERIFIED (+0.0013 RPS improvement; fully recovered and active in candidate generation).

gap_investigations.what_is_missing: Localized temperature, wind speed, precipitation, and relative humidity at stadium coordinates at kickoff time.
gap_investigations.how_often_missing: 18.3% of matches where stadium geocoordinates are unmapped or match dates lack kickoff hour.
gap_investigations.why_missing: Venue location database had unmapped stadiums for promoted clubs.
gap_investigations.which_provider: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API + Venue Location Database.
gap_investigations.recovery_cost: LOW (Open-Meteo is keyless and public domain).
gap_investigations.materially_improve_model: LOW (Ablation F3b shows weather features provide marginal delta-RPS +0.0001, valuable for totals/goals rather than 1X2 outcomes).

governance_rule: No feature is promoted into production without passing: (1) coverage test >= 95%, (2) PIT zero-lookahead test, (3) adversarial leakage test, (4) out-of-sample incremental value test, and (5) licensing verification.
